oneLiner.zh: 额度内的下载一切照旧直接给；只有超出每日额度才需要站长审批，批准后自动开跑并发 Gofile 链接
oneLiner.en: Everything within quota downloads instantly as before; only requests above the daily quota need admin approval, then run automatically and deliver a Gofile link

title.zh: 超额下载申请与站长审批

zh: ✅ 额度内一切照旧：单曲、专辑、歌单、歌手全专辑，只要在每日 200 首以内就直接开始下载，不再有任何审批门槛
📩 只有超出每日额度才会弹出申请卡：写明站长在东八区、可能不在线、批准后才开始下载、完成后发 Gofile 链接请尽快下载
🎛 申请人选的音质、歌词内嵌、中文翻译、注音会随申请一起提交，站长批准时原样执行，不会悄悄变回默认值
🔔 站长在 Telegram 里点「同意」后真正开始下载（不批准就一直不跑、不占队列），完成后 Gofile 链接同时发给申请人和站长
⏱ 申请频率：每人每小时 1 次、每天最多 3 次；一轮跑完授权即失效
🛠 修复：歌手全专辑批量下载完成后申请人收不到 Gofile 链接、申请数据只存内存重启即丢、卡住时静默无提示
en: ✅ Within quota nothing changes: singles, albums, playlists and full artist discographies start downloading immediately as long as you're inside the 200-track daily quota — no approval gate at all
📩 Only over-quota requests show a request card: it states the admin is in UTC+8 and may be offline, that the download starts only after approval, and that a Gofile link is sent afterwards
🎛 Quality, lyric embedding, Chinese translation and ruby choices are submitted along with the request and honoured exactly when approved — no silent reset to defaults
🔔 Nothing runs until the admin taps Approve in Telegram (no background jobs, no queue slot while pending); when it finishes the Gofile link goes to both the requester and the admin
⏱ Request limits: once per hour per user, up to 3 per day; the approval is single-use
🛠 Fixed: requester never received the Gofile link after a full-discography batch, request data lived only in memory and was lost on restart, and stalled jobs failed silently

title.zh: TG Bot 补齐「标签语言」选择
title.en: TG Bot Catches Up on Tag Language Selection

zh: 🏷 新增 /tags 命令：网页端的朋友早就用惯了左下角「曲库语言」，现在机器人在对话里也能选 —— 内置 19 种常用语言预设，也可直接输入任意 BCP-47 代码（如 ar-EG、ja-JP、zh-Hant-HK）
🔀 与网页端一致，标签语言和界面语言互不影响：可以「英文界面 + 日语标签」
🔍 按各地区实际支持的 supportedLanguageTags 精准匹配，而不是盲发一次就完事 —— Apple Music 遇到不支持的语言会静默回退，只发一次很容易拿到错语言
©️ 一旦你明确指定了语言，就不再转简体、不做华语艺名映射、不做跨区嗅探：要什么语言就给什么语言
💡 小提示：Apple Music 并非所有语言组合都有本地化名称（例如阿拉伯语、泰语在多数区没有），这类情况下会回退到该区默认语言，属于平台限制
en: 🏷 New /tags command: the web UI has had a catalog-language picker in the bottom-left forever — now the bot can do it in chat too. 19 built-in presets, plus any custom BCP-47 code (ar-EG, ja-JP, zh-Hant-HK…)
🔀 Matching the web UI, tag language and interface language are independent: run an English UI while tagging files in Japanese

🔍 Matches against each storefront's actual supportedLanguageTags instead of firing one blind request — Apple Music silently falls back for unsupported languages, so a single request often returns the wrong language
©️ Once you pick a language explicitly, names are kept verbatim: no simplification, no artist-alias mapping, no cross-region sniffing
💡 Heads-up: Apple Music doesn't have localized names for every language combination (Arabic and Thai are missing in most regions); those fall back to the storefront default — that's a platform limit

title.zh: 语言感知音乐标签 · TG 搜索点歌 · 歌手全辑完整分页
title.en: Language-Aware Audio Tags · TG Search · Full Artist Pagination

zh: 🏷️ 智能中英音乐标签：英文模式（English）下导出的 .m4a 内嵌标签与文件名全英文；中文模式下仅对华语曲目转简体中文，欧美/古典歌手保持英文原名
🔎 TG 机器人直接搜索：除发送链接外，现在可直接向机器人发送「歌名 / 歌手名」实时搜索并一键点歌
💿 歌手全辑完整分页：突破原先仅显示 10 张专辑的限制，自动拉取歌手名下全部录音室专辑、Live 与单曲/EP，支持跨页勾选与「仅选录音室专辑」
🔓 歌单整包全面开放：普通用户现可整包下载单曲、专辑与歌单（共享每日 200 首免费配额，已归档秒传不扣配额）
📱 手机与电脑双端优化：修复手机端专辑/歌单按钮横向溢出，移除冗余口令框，首页下载偏好设置正式接通并新增双语历史更新日志
en: 🏷️ Native English Audio Tags: In English mode, all exported .m4a metadata tags (title, artist, album, genre) and filenames are written in English
🔎 Direct Search in TG Bot: Send any song or artist name directly to the bot to search Apple Music and download without needing a link
💿 Full Artist Discography Pagination: Loads all Studio Albums, Live Albums, Singles & EPs across pages instead of only the first 10
🔓 Full Playlist Downloads for All: Standard users can now batch-download full playlists, albums, and single tracks (200 tracks/day shared quota; cached items are free)
📱 Mobile & Desktop Polish: Responsive action buttons on mobile screens, home download preferences now actually wired up, and a bilingual release history

title.zh: 超大容量自动分卷 · 断线结果找回 · 零丢歌保障
title.en: Auto-Split >4GB Archives · Disconnect Recovery · Zero-Loss Batch

zh: 📦 Gofile 4GB 自动分卷：超过 3.8GB 的大型歌单/全辑自动切卷并归集至同一分享文件夹，彻底解决大包上传断连
🛡️ 断线自动找回链接：大歌单后台打包期间即使手机锁屏或网络切换，前端也会自动轮询取回成品下载链接
🔒 同名防覆盖与错误清单：并发下载同名曲目自动编号绝不漏歌；若含无版权跳过曲目，包内自动附带 _INTERNAL_error.log.txt
en: 📦 Auto-Split >4GB Archives: Large playlists/albums over 3.8GB automatically split into parts inside a single Gofile share folder
🛡️ Disconnect Recovery: Even if your phone sleeps or network switches during a large batch, the Gofile link is automatically recovered
🔒 Zero-Overwrite & Error Log: Duplicate track titles are safely numbered; any unavailable regional tracks are listed in _INTERNAL_error.log.txt

title.zh: 杜比/无损容器底层修复 · 粤语繁简对照 · 日文罗马音注音
title.en: Dolby Atmos & ALAC Container Fix · Cantonese/Japanese Lyrics Ruby

zh: 🎧 椒盐音乐 (Salt Player) / Android 完美兼容：剥除解密残留占位盒与冗余 btrt、还原杜比 JOC 空间音频尾字节，消除「编码错误」
あ 日文歌词注音与粤语对照：支持 Apple Music 官方日文罗马音/平假名逐行注音，支持粤语/台语歌曲繁简对照双语歌词
📐 内嵌与外置歌词正交控制：内嵌歌词（©lyr）与独立外挂歌词文件（.lrc / .ttml）完全独立勾选，互不干扰
en: 🎧 Android / Salt Player Compatibility: Normalized MP4 stsd sample entries and restored Dolby Atmos JOC metadata for strict players
あ Japanese Phonetics & Translations: Added official Romaji / Hiragana phonetic guides for Japanese lyrics and bilingual translation support
📐 Orthogonal Lyrics Controls: Embedded lyrics (©lyr) and standalone external files (.lrc / .ttml) can be configured independently

title.zh: 多选勾选批量下载 · 仅下载歌词模式 · 每日配额体系
title.en: Multi-Track Selection · Lyrics-Only Mode · Fair Daily Quota

zh: ☑️ 曲目自由多选：支持在专辑或歌单列表中勾选任意几首单曲一键批量下载
📝 仅下载歌词模式：无需下载音频即可秒级提取单曲或整张专辑的 .lrc / .ttml 歌词文件
⚖️ 每日 200 首共享配额：北京时间 00:00 自动重置，所有已归档曲目/专辑秒传直发完全免配额
en: ☑️ Multi-Track Selection: Tick specific tracks inside any album or playlist for custom batch downloading
📝 Lyrics-Only Mode: Extract standalone .lrc / .ttml lyrics for a track or entire album in seconds without downloading audio
⚖️ Fair Daily Quota (200 tracks/day): Resets at 00:00 UTC+8; archived tracks and albums deliver instantly with zero quota cost

title.zh: Local Bot API 零拷贝专线 · 播放列表合辑气泡
title.en: Local Bot API Zero-Copy Tunnel · Playlist MediaGroup Bubbles

zh: 🚀 突破 50MB 限制：接入自建 Telegram Local Bot API 零拷贝专线，支持单卷最高 2GB 全辑 ZIP 极速直传
🫧 原生音频合辑气泡：整张专辑自动按黄金 5 首一组聚合为干净的 Telegram 播放列表气泡，先归档频道再秒推私聊
en: 🚀 2GB Local Bot API Tunnel: Bypassed standard 50MB bot limit via self-hosted Local Bot API with zero-copy disk streaming
🫧 Clean Playlist Bubbles: Full albums are grouped into neat 5-track Telegram audio media groups and forwarded instantly

title.zh: Web 浏览器端解密 + Gofile 云端转存 + 1400px 封面标签注入
title.en: Browser Wasm Decryption · Gofile Cloud Transfer · 1400px Artwork Tagging

zh: 🌐 双引擎架构：支持浏览器内 Wasm 原生解密本机直存，或通过 VPS 2000M 带宽一键打包转存至 Gofile 临时网盘
🖼️ 完整 iTunes 元数据：自动注入 1400×1400 高清封面、歌名、歌手、专辑、曲目编号、流派与同步时间轴歌词
en: 🌐 Dual-Engine Architecture: Decrypt directly in your browser via WebAssembly or transfer at 2000Mbps to Gofile cloud storage
🖼️ Complete iTunes Metadata: Embeds 1400×1400 artwork, title, artist, album, track/disc numbers, genre, and synced lyrics
